'''Dar''' is a Watchman from [[Baerlon]].

==Activities==

Dar and [[Arin]] open one of the city's gates to help [[Rand]] and the rest of the group escape the city. However they are interrupted by the [[Children of the Light]]. They hesitate but, under orders from a superior, they open and close the gates before the Children can cause any harm.
